$comment: Hand-entered gear the official site does not list (Guardian / New Year / other event armor and weapons).
Each record has exactly the fields of data/armor/<part>.json or data/weapons/<type>.json records, plus "source": "manual" (added by the sync if missing).
Ids: armor "ev-<set>-<part>" (kebab-case), weapons "ev_<name>" (snake_case), so they never collide with official ids.
image: the official art when you have it (public/images/armor|weapons/<id>.webp), otherwise any existing /images/**.webp such as a monster crest.
The sync appends these after the official records; removing one here removes it from data/. When the official site later lists the same gear by name, the sync report says so.
_example shows the shape and is ignored.
